mapper.sql: p.audit_status = 1 AND p.visibility = 0 AND p.deleted = 0 AND (p.circle_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM circle c WHERE c.id = p.circle_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.type = 0)) AND (p.share_post_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post original WHERE original.id = p.share_post_id AND original.deleted = 0 AND original.audit_status = 1 AND original.visibility = 0 AND original.share_post_id IS NULL AND (original.circle_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM circle oc WHERE oc.id = original.circle_id AND oc.deleted = 0 AND oc.status = 1 AND oc.type = 0))))
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM post p WHERE ORDER BY ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_collect lc WHERE lc.target_id = p.id AND lc.type = 1 ) DESC, p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.* FROM post p WHERE ORDER BY ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_collect lc WHERE lc.target_id = p.id AND lc.type = 1) * 1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) * 2 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_collect lcc WHERE lcc.target_id = p.id AND lcc.type = 3) * 3 ) DESC, p.create_time DESC
SELECT p.* FROM post p WHERE ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
